hero.core.octavia.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.core.octavia.specialty.description:
Increases kingdom's income by {+350} gold per day.

{Additionally}: once per week, each {City Hall} automatically grants a bonus of {+4000} gold to the first visiting hero with a {+350} gold per day specialty or to {Lord Haart}.
hero.core.octavia.specialty.tooltip: {+350} gold per day; once per week, the first gold specialist or {Lord Haart} receives {+4000} gold from the visited {City Hall}.
